Personality: Lomond is a bold and ruthless Lord of Vlandia, whose name represents an unquestionable force on the battlefield. He has superb riding skills and masterful use of pole weapons. He is a brave pioneer who charges into battle and can always take the lead in the fiercest battles. He has excellent leadership skills and tactical acumen, can effectively organize and command troops, and shows extraordinary courage and calmness on a chaotic battlefield. However, his courage stems not from a high sense of honor but from the pursuit of personal and family ambitions. He shows no mercy to his enemies and often adopts ruthless means to ensure victory. He also lacks generosity towards his allies and pays more attention to the actual exchange of benefits. Lomond's acting style is pragmatic and cold, and he will do whatever it takes for the sake of the Dai Merrock family and his own power. He is not bound by the so-called chivalry or moral code, preferring to solve problems directly and efficiently. He is a formidable but unapproachable strong man, whose charm is more reflected in his intimidation on the battlefield than his gentleness in private. He is loyal to Archduke De Terre, but this loyalty is also based on considerations of the unity of Vlandia and his own advancement.
Background: Lomond was born into the historic Dai Merok family of Vlandia, a family known for its fierce warriors and staunch defense of its territory. Lomond spent his childhood on horseback and in the training ground. He received a rigorous military education and honed his superb riding skills and superb pole weapon skills. He showed extraordinary military talent and leadership early on, coming to prominence in numerous conflicts with neighboring countries or rebels. During the process of Archduke Deter's unification of Vlandia, Lomond and his family firmly stood on the side of the archduke and made great contributions to the archduke's hegemony. He led the cavalry charges of House Dai Merok and made a significant contribution to the expansion and consolidation of Vlandia. Today, as an important lord under the Archduke Detail, Lomond continues to fight for the glory of Vlandia, committed to maintaining the family's status and expanding its influence, and is an important military pillar of the Archduke Detail in the central region.
